title: 产品设计目录布局
author: PromptLab
categories: 产品营销,海报 / 传单,摄影,草图 / 线稿,极简主义,产品,建筑 / 室内,图解 / 图表
prompt_en:
Create a vertical 3:4 product design catalog page with a warm neutral paper-like background.

Top section — lifestyle hero shot: place the product (use the uploaded image as the exact reference, preserving its form, proportions, materials, and identity without redesign) center-dominant with generous whitespace. Setting is a minimal architectural interior with a textured plaster wall and subtle concrete/stone floor. Lighting is natural sunlight angled from the side, soft but casting high-contrast shadows. Render in editorial lifestyle photography style, high realism, warm and muted color grading.

Bottom section — technical specification panel laid out in a clean modular grid:
- Bottom left and center: orthographic architectural line drawings showing front view, side view, and three-quarter cutaway/profile view. Lines in muted red or sepia, fine technical weight, with minimal editorial measurement and construction callouts.
- Bottom right: 3-4 material swatch samples derived from the product's actual materials (fabric, leather, metal, wood, or plastic as applicable), in square or rectangular format with small editorial captions.

Typography: minimal editorial style, subtle captions only, no large headlines, soft black or dark brown.

Overall mood: design catalog / product design journal — architectural, premium, calm. No clutter, no bold colors, no heavy branding, no decorative graphics, no perspective distortion in the technical drawings.\

title: 巴黎秋季街拍风格写真
author: Creative Diffusion
categories: 产品营销,电商主图,摄影,网红 / 模特,时尚单品
prompt_en: A high-end lifestyle e-commerce photo of a stylish woman walking along a quiet Parisian street in autumn, captured from behind in a candid editorial moment. She is centered slightly left, mid-stride on a cobblestone-and-pavement sidewalk, turning her head gently toward the elegant Haussmann apartment buildings lined with wrought-iron balconies and flower boxes. She wears a long tailored wool coat in camel beige, dark straight-leg trousers, and dark brown leather ankle boots, with a structured leather crossbody satchel in warm tan hanging at her hip. She has shoulder-length wavy dark brown hair and holds a folded newspaper or magazine in one hand. The street includes exactly 6 black metal bollards visible in the foreground and midground, scattered dry autumn leaves on the ground, and tall trees on the right side with golden-brown foliage. In the background, softly blurred pedestrians walk down the boulevard, and a corner café with the visible sign CAFÉ LE PARISIEN appears on the left, with the same café name faintly repeated farther down the street. Warm golden-hour lighting, shallow depth of field, natural skin tones, creamy background bokeh, refined neutral color palette, luxury travel editorial styling, realistic photography, vertical composition, 4:5 aspect ratio, premium advertising image quality.\

title: 时尚编辑彩盒
author: aiiStudio
categories: 产品营销,海报 / 传单,摄影,3D 渲染,网红 / 模特,时尚单品
prompt_en:
Use the person in the input image as the ONLY subject. Preserve their identity and facial features clearly.

Create a hyper-realistic high-fashion editorial photo inside a surreal 3D geometric “color box” room (a hollow cube / tilted cube set). Each render MUST randomly choose:
1) a bold single-color box (monochrome environment, vivid and saturated),
2) a dynamic “cool” fashion pose (gravity-defying or extreme stretch / leap / sideways bracing against the walls),
3) a dramatic camera angle (wide-angle 24–35mm equivalent, tilted horizon, strong perspective).

The subject appears full-body and sharp, wearing an avant-garde fashion styling that feels modern and editorial (clean silhouette, stylish layering, premium fabric texture). Keep clothing tasteful and fashion-forward. The subject’s pose should feel athletic, stylish, and unusual—like a magazine campaign shot.

Lighting: studio quality, crisp and cinematic; strong key light with controlled soft shadows, subtle rim light; realistic reflections and bounce light from the colored walls. Ultra-detailed skin texture, natural pores, realistic fabric weave, clean edges, high dynamic range. 
Composition: subject centered with plenty of negative space and strong geometric lines; the box perspective frames the subject. 
Color: the box color is a SINGLE bold color and MUST be different each run (random vivid hue). The subject’s outfit contrasts well with the box color.

Output: hyper-real, photorealistic, 8k detail, editorial campaign quality, sharp focus on subject, no motion blur, no distortion of face, natural proportions.\

title: 诡异感恩节家庭晚餐
author: 唐华斑竹🦅
categories: 漫画 / 分镜,摄影,复古 / 怀旧,群像 / 情侣,美食 / 饮品
prompt_en: Create a photorealistic, slightly unsettling 1970s–1980s American Thanksgiving family dinner scene in a cozy but old-fashioned dining room. Use a 4:3 horizontal composition, warm dim indoor lighting, muted brown and cream tones, and a documentary snapshot aesthetic with realistic imperfections. Show exactly 9 people seated around a round table: 1 young adult man in a white shirt at far left, 1 woman beside him in brown, 1 middle-aged man in a white shirt and dark tie, 1 middle-aged woman in a pale floral blouse at the center, 1 young girl in a plaid dress and headband, 1 elderly man in a dark suit, 1 elderly woman in a dark patterned dress at far right, 1 boy seated with his back to the camera in the foreground, and 1 partially obscured person near the left side of the table. Make all human faces deliberately anonymized with soft rectangular blur blocks, increasing the uncanny realism. The table should be covered with a white lace tablecloth and crowded with exactly 8 visible food items: a large roasted turkey in the center, a bowl of green beans, a bowl of cranberry sauce, a bowl of mashed potatoes, a basket of dinner rolls, a rectangular baked casserole, a stuffing dish, and small plates of sliced food around the place settings. Include plates, forks, knives, spoons, drinking glasses, and napkins arranged realistically. Add exactly 3 pets: a gray tabby cat sitting on a small wooden stool at the lower left, a large German shepherd lying on the carpet in the foreground, and a brown hound dog standing in the kitchen doorway at the right rear. Background details: floral wallpaper, lace curtains glowing from a window on the left, a wooden china cabinet filled with plates and glassware centered on the back wall, autumn harvest decorations on top of the cabinet, small framed pictures, a black wall cross to the right, and a view into a wood-cabinet kitchen through the doorway. Add a faint blurred watermark-like block in the bottom-right corner. No readable text, no modern objects, no clean studio lighting; keep the image realistic, nostalgic, and subtly eerie.\

prompt_en: Create a raw neo-expressionist mixed-media painting on a dirty off-white canvas, dominated by a front-facing lion head with a gaunt, exhausted, slightly deranged expression. The lion has a huge scruffy mane in ochre, burnt orange, brown, black, and yellow, with spiky hair tufts radiating upward, asymmetrical wide circular eyes, a long yellow muzzle, a black nose, thin whiskers, and clenched vertical teeth like a grimace. Use dense scratched linework, splattered paint, dry-brush texture, scraped marks, drips, cracks, and chaotic graffiti-like scribbles across the whole surface, evoking Jean-Michel Basquiat-inspired outsider art. The background is a distressed cream wall filled with exactly 6 small doodle elements: a black-rayed sun in the upper left, a red circular face-like symbol on the left, a blue rectangular figure with a tiny face on the mid-left, a black boxed face near the lower left, a tall stick-figure face in the upper right, and a black rectangular panel with white occult-like symbols in the lower right. Keep the composition square, tightly cropped around the lion's face, with high contrast, messy hand-drawn energy, no clean digital polish, and a gritty gallery-painting texture. Customize the subject as lion, the emotional expression as gaunt and exhausted, the dominant palette as ochre, burnt orange, brown, black, yellow, and dirty cream, the art style as neo-expressionist mixed-media graffiti painting, and the canvas format as square.\

title: 柔和的蓝莓蛋糕动漫海报
author: 千菊
categories: 海报 / 传单,动漫 / 漫画,插画,角色,文字 / 排版
prompt_en: A dreamy pastel-purple Japanese movie poster illustration in a glossy shoujo anime style, packed with blueberry dessert chaos and soft sparkles. The scene shows 1 seated teenage girl with a short silver-lavender bob haircut, side bangs, a small lavender bow hair clip, and alternative cute fashion, sitting on the floor in a messy kitchen or baking workspace. Her face is intentionally covered by a centered square censor block in muted lavender-gray. She wears an oversized translucent lavender jacket with black ribbon details on the sleeves, a light purple graphic top, layered silver necklaces, a purple plaid skirt, slouchy white leg warmers decorated with lavender heart patches and black bows, and chunky lavender platform sneakers with ribbon accents. She holds 1 blueberry near her mouth with one hand and 1 metal mixing bowl smeared with vivid purple blueberry batter in the other. In front of her is 1 large golden pound cake split open dramatically, overflowing with dark glossy blueberries and purple filling, spilling across 1 cooling rack and the tabletop. Counted blueberries are scattered throughout the composition as floating and resting props, creating a whimsical suspended effect. The environment is cluttered with baking tools and notes: 1 spiral notebook page in the upper right labeled in English with a handwritten recipe for blueberry pound cake, 1 whisk in the lower right, 1 small pinned photo print in the lower left showing 2 anime girls, and 1 handwritten note card in the lower right with Japanese writing and a small bunny doodle. Use a monochrome palette of lilac, violet, periwinkle, cream, and deep blueberry purple, with luminous highlights, soft haze, translucent overlays, and romantic glitter. Add large expressive Japanese calligraphy text dominating the left half of the poster, reading vertically and diagonally like a dramatic light-novel or film advertisement, plus a ribbon banner near the cake with the date text “2026年7月メロードショー”, vertical copy on the right side, small production-credit text across the bottom, and a final tagline line at the very bottom. Make the composition feel like a cute disaster: beautiful but failed baking, sweet melancholy, fashionable messiness, and cinematic promotional poster energy.\

prompt_en: Create a retro pixel-art risograph print illustration on aged cream paper, showing a person with a pink bob haircut eating noodles with chopsticks seated at a small restaurant table. Use a square dark teal-green background panel centered on the page with a thick cream paper margin, heavy risograph grain, imperfect ink registration, halftone speckles, and chunky low-resolution pixel edges. The subject should occupy the right half of the panel, wearing a yellow sweater with a dark green pinafore-style apron; their face is intentionally hidden by a flat rectangular soft pink-to-tan gradient block. Show the person holding exactly 2 chopsticks horizontally in the left hand and lifting exactly 1 strand cluster of noodles with the right hand. Include exactly 4 main table items: 1 dark green bottle with a red-and-blue label on the left, 1 small oval side plate with a red rectangular food item, 1 large oval plate of yellow-orange fried noodles with blue rim details and small green garnish, and 1 brown tabletop spanning the bottom. Include exactly 1 hanging orange paper lantern in the upper left, attached by 1 thin vertical cord, with yellow highlights and pixelated edges. Use a limited risograph palette of deep teal, mustard yellow, orange, coral pink, red, cobalt blue, dark green, and cream paper, with no photorealism, no smooth vector lines, no extra people, no readable text, and no watermark.\

author: Shinning
categories: 产品营销,海报 / 传单,摄影,3D 渲染,产品,网红 / 模特
prompt_en:
Create a premium high-end commercial advertising poster for the NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 graphics card, with the graphics card as the dominant hero product. Use the uploaded portrait photo only as the appearance and hairstyle reference for the female model: preserve face shape, facial features, hairstyle, skin tone, body proportion, and overall temperament; do not copy the original expression, clothing, background, lighting, or pose. The model appears as a confident next-generation creator/gamer in refined modern techwear styling, positioned beside the GPU with a natural product relationship, as if presenting the power of the card. Futuristic black, gunmetal, silver, and electric green color system; cinematic studio lighting; sharp rim light; subtle volumetric glow; premium reflective materials; precise product edges; realistic cooling fins, fan details, and metal texture. Composition: vertical social-media launch poster, 4:5 ratio, product large in the foreground, model in three-quarter pose behind or beside it, strong depth, clean negative space for typography. Poster headline: “GEFORCE RTX 5090”. Subtitle: “Frames Beyond Limits”. Typography should feel clean, precise, futuristic, premium, and integrated into the scene without clutter. High-end electronics campaign visual, luxury tech advertising photography, realistic, ultra-detailed, polished, no watermark.

watermark, random text, misspelled headline, garbled letters, logo distortion, low quality, blurry, plastic skin, extra fingers, deformed hands, bad anatomy, overexposed highlights, unrealistic lighting, oversmoothed skin, cheap e-commerce look, AI-generated look, warped electronics, melted GPU shape, incorrect fan structure, bent circuit board, cluttered background, exaggerated gaming cliché, distorted face, identity drift\

prompt_en:
Goal: Create a highly detailed vertical music-community poster about sound crossing eras, borders, gender, age, analog media, and digital media, with a luminous fantasy-realism collage of humanity connected by music.

Canvas: Vertical 2:3 poster, cinematic ultra-detailed digital painting, warm sunset golds blended with neon blues, purples, and pinks. No margins; fill the entire canvas with layered scenes and glowing musical motion.

Central composition: Place a large radiant white-gold circular burst in the exact center, like a sun made of sound waves and stardust. Over it, set the main Japanese headline 音で繋がれ in large dark navy calligraphic serif characters. Beneath it, place three centered smaller Japanese lines: 時代も国境も性別も年齢も, アナログもデジタルも, and 「音」は垣根を超えて届く. Keep the text crisp and readable against the glowing center.

Main visual motif: A huge spiral ribbon of light and music notation wraps around the poster from lower left to center, then across the middle and upper right, then back through the bottom. The ribbon contains glowing staff lines, eighth notes, treble-like music symbols, particles, waveform sparks, small app-like music icons, and digital pixels. It should feel like sound physically connecting every scene.

Layout: Build exactly 7 major connected scene zones around the central headline:
1. Upper left prehistoric / tribal campfire music: people dancing, drumming, singing around a fire under a starry sky.
2. Upper center ancient classical world: ruins resembling Greek or Roman columns, musicians with cello, flute, hand drums, and traditional string instruments under a golden sunset.
3. Upper right East Asian historical music scene: Japanese temple roofs, pagoda, cherry blossoms, shamisen players, kimono-like clothing, and lantern glow.
4. Middle left ancient desert / world heritage scene: pyramids in the background, musicians with guitar-like and percussion instruments, travelers and dancers.
5. Middle center modern global city concert: skyline, high-rises, diverse band members, singers, guitarists, saxophone, brass, and crowd energy.
6. Middle right futuristic digital DJ / electronic music scene: DJ at a glowing mixer, laptop-like screens, neon equalizers, holographic icons, synthesizer lights, and cyberpunk purple-blue ambience.
7. Bottom global community gathering: children, adults, elders, people of different cultures and abilities sitting and standing in a circle, including a wheelchair user, acoustic guitars, headphones, a laptop music workstation, city lights, temples, domes, and a final row of silhouettes holding hands along the horizon.

People and instruments: Show a large diverse ensemble of roughly 70 visible people total across the poster, mixing ages from children to elders, different skin tones, body types, genders, historical costumes, modern streetwear, traditional clothing, and futuristic outfits. Include exactly 16 clearly featured instrument or music-making categories: hand drums, frame drums, flute, cello, shamisen, lute-like instrument, acoustic guitar, electric guitar, bass guitar, saxophone, trumpet, violin, microphone singing, DJ controller, laptop digital audio workstation, and headphones. Some faces may be small or impressionistic, but the mood must be joyful, communal, and inclusive.

Style: Epic fantasy realism meets Japanese festival poster and generative-AI music community art. Extremely dense, ornate, and luminous; painterly yet sharp; dramatic sky gradients; sparkling particles; cinematic rim light; rich historical detail; neon digital overlays; sweeping depth from foreground to distant skyline. Use vibrant contrast between ancient firelight, sunset gold, and futuristic cyan-magenta glow.

Constraints: Do not leave empty space except for the central text glow. Keep all typography in Japanese exactly as specified. Avoid logos, watermarks, brand names, random extra text, malformed music notation dominating the headline, or horror/dark dystopian mood. The final image should communicate: sound connects everyone beyond time, nations, gender, age, analog, and digital.\

Canvas: Vertical 3:4 sports trading-card composition, tightly framed from mid-torso to head, with a premium green-and-gold metallic border inspired by Brazil colors.

Main subject: Center a confident female Brazilian soccer fan/player with long wavy blonde hair, wearing a yellow Brazil national team jersey with green trim. The jersey shows exactly 4 visible markings: a green Nike-style swoosh on the viewer-left chest, a Brazil/CBF crest with stars on the viewer-right chest, the word “BRASIL” beneath the crest, and a large green number “10” centered on the torso. Her face area should be covered by a plain rectangular skin-toned placeholder block, as if anonymized or reserved for a user portrait.

Background: Use a packed soccer stadium with blurred yellow-and-green crowd colors, bright arena lights, blue sky, and depth-of-field blur. Include a large waving Brazil flag on the left side of the stadium background and a distant scoreboard on the right showing a trophy-like icon in green/yellow tones.

Top elements: At the top center, place a dark green beveled nameplate with gold edges containing the white italic text “World Cup 2026”. Add exactly 2 top corner badges: on the upper left, a rounded rectangle badge containing the Brazil flag; on the upper right, a shield badge containing a black-and-white soccer ball and three white stars.

Bottom elements: Add a large gold FIFA-style World Cup trophy in the lower-left corner, overlapping the frame. Across the bottom, place a wide black textured metallic nameplate with gold bevels and screws, containing the large gold italic name “Danviane Aetherlux”. Beneath it, add a small green plaque with gold trim reading “FAN-01”.

Style: Hyper-realistic sports poster and collectible sticker aesthetic, sharp glossy highlights, embossed metallic gold trim, saturated Brazil green/yellow palette, cinematic lighting, high contrast, polished commercial finish.

Constraints: Keep the exact visible text: “World Cup 2026”, “Danviane Aetherlux”, “FAN-01”, “BRASIL”, and “10”. Use exactly 2 top badges and 1 trophy. Do not add extra logos, watermarks, QR codes, or additional text.\

prompt_en:
A dramatic ultra-detailed vertical anime key visual poster showing a crossover war between Japan’s Sengoku era and China’s Three Kingdoms era, split exactly down the center by a glowing vertical beam of light. The left half is themed in crimson, magenta, ember orange, and cherry blossom pink, representing 日本戦国; the right half is themed in jade green, teal, cyan, gold, and stormy blue, representing 中国三国. At the center, large vertical Japanese calligraphy reads 時空を越え、宿命が交錯する。. The composition is dense, cinematic, and symmetrical, like a premium game or movie crossover poster, with dozens of sparks, petals, glowing particles, motion streaks, and layered background architecture.

On the left side, depict 4 distinct Sengoku-themed warriors. At the top left, a stern samurai warlord in ornate black and deep red armor with gold trim, long dark hair tied high and blowing in the wind, shown in a powerful upper-body portrait facing inward; behind him are sakura blossoms, banners, and stacked Japanese castles illuminated with neon-magenta highlights. Mid-left, show 1 battle-hardened older general with wild silver hair, heavy layered armor, and a fierce glare, partially emerging from the fortress cityscape. Lower-left, show 1 aggressive crimson-clad warrior lunging forward with sweeping cloth, horned or antler-like helmet ornamentation, and dynamic red-black armor. At the bottom-left foreground, show 1 dominant swordsman in demonic samurai armor with a crescent-moon helmet crest and glowing red eyes, gripping a katana angled diagonally downward, surrounded by embers and petals. A vertical banner near the upper-left edge displays the Japanese text 日本戦国.

On the right side, depict 4 distinct Three Kingdoms-themed heroes. At the top right, show 1 regal strategist-emperor figure in elaborate blue, black, and gold ceremonial armor with a tall crown-like headdress, shown in upper-body profile facing inward; behind him rises a luminous spectral dragon made of water, cloud, and light. Mid-right, show 1 long-bearded green-robed general with a tall headpiece and lamellar armor, solemn and heroic, framed by neon-lit city structures and swirling magical energy. Slightly below center-right, show 1 elegant strategist-scholar holding an opened feather fan, wearing layered robes and gold ornaments, calm and calculating. At the lower-right edge, show 1 roaring armored warrior with a fierce expression and windblown hair. In the bottom-right foreground, make the dominant figure a green-and-gold armored hero extending a glowing jade-green sword toward the viewer, with flowing robes and luminous energy ribbons curling around the blade. A vertical banner near the upper-right edge displays the Chinese text 中国三国.

Blend historical East Asian war aesthetics with futuristic cyberpunk megacity elements: Japanese pagodas and fortresses on the left, neon skyscrapers and glowing urban lights across both halves, flying fortress silhouettes and distant airborne warships in the sky, magical lightning, smoke, and storm clouds overhead. The sky transitions from sunset violet and rose on the left to stormy turquoise and silver on the right. Use hyper-detailed painterly anime illustration, intricate armor textures, metallic reflections, volumetric lighting, high contrast, epic scale, and intense atmosphere.

At the bottom, add huge stylized title typography: on the left, massive fiery kanji 戦国 with the romanization SENGOKU beneath it; in the middle, a metallic gold VS; on the right, massive jade-glowing kanji 三国 with the romanization SANGOKU beneath it. Below that, add a smaller centered subtitle line reading SENGOKU VS SANGOKU, and beneath it a Japanese tagline: 時空を超え、英雄たちの戦いが始まる。.
